sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
2.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the N.B.W. order dated 23.10.2013 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 17, Etah in Case No. 67 of 2005 (State Vs. owner Tarun Kumar Yadav and another), under Sections 7/16 Food Adulteration and Prevention Act, Police Station - Jalesar, District - Etah.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 17, Etah
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Case No. 67 of 2005 (State Vs. owner Tarun Kumar Yadav and another)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Shri Rajesh Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant submits that N.B.W has been issued against the applicant vide order dated 23.10.2013 in the case arising out of offence under Food Adulteration and Prevention Act.
He further submits that applicant is ready to appear before the concerned Trial Court.
He prayed that N.B.W. issued against the applicant be kept in abeyance.

Lokendra Pal Singh@ Lokpal Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 1 July, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120843802/

entities.text: Lokendra Pal Singh@ Lokpal Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 1 July, 2022 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned A.G.A. has no objection for the aforesaid prayer.
5.

Considering the submissions and also taking note that case is arising out of Food Adulteration and Prevention Act, therefore, N.B.W. dated 23.10.2013 issued against the applicant be kept in abeyance till 08.07.2022, meanwhile the applicant undertakes to surrender and file appropriate application before the concerned Trial Court which will be consider in accordance with law.
In default, the concerned Trial Court is at liberty to take appropriate steps for his appearance, in accordance with law.
6. With the aforesaid directions, the present application is finally disposed of.
